tucked in or untucked.

the most unnecessary debate in menswear.

we removed the pockets on the latest prototype because nobody actually carries anything in them anyway.

cleaner lines or bad design?

if your pockets are bulging with a wallet, keys, and phone, your clothes don't fit well.

simple as that.

the feeling of putting on a shirt that finally fits perfectly after hunting for six months.

that feeling beats any trend.
